function.name: read_object_text
function.description:
Retrieve the text content of a site object (page, layout, view, script, style, api, codeblock).
Both nameOrId and objectType are required; a name alone is insufficient. Use the object's name or ID and its objectType from list_site_object or an installation receipt such as create_app_base.objects (map name to nameOrId). For example: {"nameOrId":"Services.user","objectType":"CodeBlock"}.
Omit lineNumber to read the full text, or supply a 1-based center line and a nonnegative range. Before update_text_object, use showLineNumber=false to obtain exact source text. Numbered output adds display prefixes only; remove those prefixes before matching. Original line endings are preserved and no final newline is added.

lineNumber.description: Optional 1-based center line number, 1 to 2147483647. Omit or null returns the full text.

range.description: Number of lines before and after LineNumber, 0 to 2147483647. Defaults to 20; 0 reads only the selected line. Ignored when lineNumber is omitted, but must still be nonnegative.

showLineNumber.description: Default false: return exact source text for oldContent matching. True: prefix each source line with its 1-based number and | for display. Prefixes are not source code. Original LF/CRLF and final-newline presence are preserved; no synthetic empty EOF line is shown.

sandbox.description: Optional sandbox name. Executes the operation in that sandbox site when provided.
